title: 配售拿不够：上市后加仓，中国新机会以前买不到？
speaker: Nicholas Choi

segments.en: Do you come in in the secondary market, or do you try and get an allocation? I know this is generalizing things, but what's the holding period looking like?
segments.zh: 你们是在二级市场进入，还是试图获得配售？我知道这有点笼统，但持有期大概是怎样的？

segments.en: Yeah. So, we've tried to go into these deals at IPO, and hold on to them. So, that's been our base. The best type of IPO investor. Correct.
segments.zh: 是的。我们试图在新股发行时参与这些交易，并长期持有。这是我们的基础。最佳类型的新股参与者。没错。

segments.en: And that's still the large majority of that, where we've been able to get decent allocations that we're able to hang on at a good price, and I guess where there are certain circumstances where we've actually added on post market as well.
segments.zh: 这仍然占大多数，我们能够获得不错的配售，以好价格持有，在某些情况下我们也会在上市后加仓。

segments.en: Because allocations are very difficult to come by. So, it isn't like I get the full allocation that I really want at the IPO itself.
segments.zh: 因为配售非常难获得。所以并不是说我在新股发行时就能得到我真正想要的完整配售。

segments.en: So, there are actually numerous cases where we've had to add on. But the interesting thing here is the conviction levels that we have on these names, where we add on, would be quite high.
segments.zh: 所以实际上有很多情况下我们不得不加仓。但有趣的是，我们对这些加仓标的的信心水平相当高。

segments.en: Because we do the work, we're spending the time, but ultimately it represents a new opportunity set that's actually presented to us in China. That, you know, kind of in the past, we wouldn't have been able to invest in.
segments.zh: 因为我们做功课，花时间，但最终它代表了在中国呈现给我们的新机会集。过去我们无法参与。
